title: Claude Time Credit experiment economy

sources.note: SHA-256 04b474308dc86493482639088f4e1bc8b58a7bdc4cab25fffc17304dcb1fd30f; uploaded by user; 26 synthetic unit tests passed locally

purpose: Account for worker, referee and human time in Time Credits with frozen task cards and independently verified paying gates; economy is opt-in, not Gym law.

inputs.meaning: Frozen runnable task allowance, par and benchmark
Actual ledger with verified event chronology and evidence refs

outputs.meaning: Source-labelled spend, gates, earned credits and uncertainty

preconditions: Actual task runnable and suite+oracle frozen
Evidence of independent referee, clocks and rate card freeze
forbidden: Use synthetic demo as real agent performance
Convert unknown token/USD costs without sourced rate
blockers: SDK-FAIL-01 task explicitly deferred until real failing test/oracle
Payment policy, par, allowance and experimental incentive adoption not approved

gates.check: Public and oracle pass and seal order
Token cap only with measured usage
USD cap only with sourced costs

outputs.meaning: Derived credit statement, no self-awarded pay
No automatic impact on owner policy

claims: Local test suite passed 26/26 on supplied ZIP, synthetic ledgers only
limitations: Time Credit payments/penalties are optimization incentives, not independent correctness nor owner authority
No measured real agent class advantage
Claude R0 is E0 x3 calibration on C1; its R1 is nine matched E0/PROTO/SEEDED executions, NOT the five heterogeneous Gym B1 pilot

controls: SEEDED protocol plus verified historical source pack

design.stream0: Controller/harness preparation and actual executor census, not a paid Gym arm

round1.difference: PROTO adds evidence discipline; SEEDED adds frozen source-linked historical Elephant intelligence to PROTO

design.result_interpretation: N=3 is exploratory; supported effect requires direction replication over C1 and C3 with adequate n
design.no_payment_if: any paying gate FAIL, UNKNOWN remains null not zero
design.costs: Worker time plus referee plus human intervention plus surcharge; token/USD stay separately UNKNOWN unless sourced/frozen
design.risk: Optimization reward for easy fixed tasks may conflict with exploration and owner-v0.5 discovery. Never substitute credits for capability.
